d: Lead merchant acquisition, onboarding coordination, portfolio growth, retention and merchant service performance across Thawani Pay's digital payment ecosystem. Deliver sustainable transaction and revenue growth while ensuring all merchant activities follow approved commercial authorities, applicable Central Bank of Oman requirements and internal risk and compliance controls.
Department: Business Development / Merchant Acquisition & Management
Reports to: Chief Business Officer / Head of Merchant Business
q: Coordinate merchant activation, technical integration and payment acceptance readiness with Technology and Operations.
Track incidents, integration failures, settlement inquiries and support tickets through documented escalation and closure.
Contribute merchant requirements to product improvements, testing, launch readiness and training.
Identify repeat service failures and implement process improvements with accountable owners.
Support merchant communications during planned service changes and operational disruptions.
Apply CBO payment service provider obligations and Thawani Pay merchant onboarding, AML/CFT, sanctions and fraud controls relevant to the role.
Escalate suspicious activity, prohibited sectors, inconsistent business information, unusual merchant behavior and potential fraud indicators promptly.
Respect segregation of duties: business acquisition does not override KYB, compliance, risk acceptance or merchant suspension decisions.
Support internal audit, regulatory examinations, merchant reviews and evidence requests.
Maintain complete, accurate and secure records of contracts, approvals, exceptions, communications and corrective actions.
Ensure any pricing exceptions, high-risk relationships and material issues receive documented approval under the DoA.
Supervise assigned merchant acquisition and relationship staff, set objectives and review performance.
Coach team members on negotiation, customer service, pipeline discipline and compliance expectations.
Lead weekly pipeline meetings and coordinate with Business, Finance, Operations, Technology, Legal, HR and Risk & Compliance.
Prepare weekly acquisition and onboarding reports, monthly portfolio dashboards and quarterly strategic reviews.
Maintain action trackers and escalate overdue issues, significant risks and revenue variances to management.
Weekly: acquisition pipeline, onboarding/activation tracker and issue escalation summary.
Monthly: revenue and transaction dashboard, retention analysis, merchant complaints and risk action tracker.
Quarterly: merchant portfolio review, strategic merchant opportunities and corrective action status.
Annually: merchant growth plan, budget input and team performance assessment.
Merchant acquisition & growth – 20%: approved, activated new merchants vs target.
Revenue & transaction growth – 20%: revenue and transaction value/volume vs plan.
Activation & retention – 15%: active merchant rate, retention and reactivation.
Onboarding efficiency – 15%: turnaround time and SLA achievement.
Merchant service quality – 10%: complaint resolution and satisfaction.
Risk & compliance – 10%: timely escalations, KYB clearance and assigned findings closure.
Team & reporting – 10%: team objectives, reporting quality and development.
KPI targets, thresholds and calculation methodologies require management approval before use in formal evaluation.
May lead acquisition plans, pipeline reviews, merchant relationship activities and team task allocation within approved remit.
May negotiate commercial terms only within authorized limits; exceptions require formal approval.
Must not independently approve KYB/AML exceptions, bypass onboarding controls, release blocked merchants or make regulatory risk-acceptance decisions.
Material merchant disputes, risk issues and expenditure are escalated according to the approved Delegation of Authority.
Typically 5–7 years of relevant merchant acquiring, banking, payments, fintech or business development experience.
Prior team leadership or portfolio management experience preferred.
Knowledge of payment gateways, QR payments, digital wallets, merchant onboarding and settlement workflows.
Strong commercial negotiation, analytics, stakeholder management and written reporting skills.
Working knowledge of Omani payment services environment and applicable AML/CFT obligations.
Strong English communication; Arabic is an advantage.
Bachelor's degree in business, finance, marketing, economics or related discipline.
r: Develop annual, quarterly and monthly merchant acquisition plans, segment priorities and sales targets aligned to approved business strategy.
Identify and prospect merchants across retail, e-commerce, hospitality, healthcare, education, SMEs and approved institutional segments.
Lead commercial engagement, proposals and negotiations within approved pricing and delegation limits.
Maintain a qualified sales pipeline, conversion forecasts, opportunity owners and target activation dates.
Develop strategic partnerships and cross-selling opportunities for approved payment solutions.
Track market developments, competitor propositions and merchant feedback; propose commercially viable improvements.
Own the business-side onboarding journey from application through documentation, internal review, integration and activation.
Ensure collection of required business registration, licensing, beneficial ownership, authorized signatory, bank account and expected transaction information, as applicable.
Coordinate with Risk & Compliance on KYB, sanctions/PEP screening, merchant risk assessment and enhanced due diligence.
Track onboarding turnaround times, documentation deficiencies, pending approvals and root causes of delay.
Ensure no merchant is activated without the necessary approvals and complete contractual and operational requirements.
Support periodic merchant data refresh, re-screening and remediation requests.
Act as business escalation owner for key merchants and ensure timely cross-functional issue resolution.
Develop structured engagement plans for strategic, high-value and at-risk merchants.
Review merchant satisfaction, complaint trends, service issues and attrition indicators.
Implement approved retention and reactivation campaigns for inactive or low-activity merchants.
Conduct periodic business reviews with priority merchants and document agreed actions.
Monitor merchant transaction values, volumes, revenue, active rate, retention, conversion and portfolio profitability.
Identify growth opportunities through increased product adoption, transaction activity and merchant coverage.
Coordinate with Finance on revenue validation, commercial pricing, settlement-related concerns and profitability analysis.
Monitor merchant and sector concentration and refer emerging exposures to Risk & Compliance.
Prepare rolling forecasts, performance variance explanations and corrective action plans.

d: We are looking for a passionate Brand Manager to become part of our Regional Brand team located in the Dubai talabat office. This role is pivotal in bringing to life the brand identity & vision and in building brand love for talabat across our 8 markets and amongst our employees, vendors and customers. You will help in guiding and shaping initiatives for these main stakeholders from a brand perspective. You will deep dive into our brand love audience and ensure our brand communications and activations are well catered to them. Have your passport ready, travel to our markets is certainly on the menu.
Build and own a brand platform; develop a unifying creative idea and occasion-led operating system that every campaign, partnership, and channel expression is built around.

Drive brand presence on emerging and high-impact channels; establish talabat's presence on emerging and high-impact channels and develop a repeatable test-and-learn model for owned social that builds brand love and engagement beyond promotional content.

Own the regional partnership and sponsorship pipeline; proactively scan culture, score opportunities against brand identity and audience fit, and drive partnerships that build regional brand equity, not just commercial deals.
Connect brand investment to commercial outcomes; co-develop the brand-to-performance consumer journey with cross-functional teams, ensuring upper-funnel brand work is measurably linked to conversion.

Develop AI-powered brand tools and intelligence; build or commission AI-assisted systems that give markets and agencies instant access to brand guidelines, precedents, and asset governance, improving brand consistency at scale.
Champion AI as a working practice; continuously embed AI tools into team workflows to sharpen processes, manage capacity more effectively, and amplify the quality and pace of output.
Evolve how strategy reaches our markets; transform brand guidance into interactive, searchable, decision-ready tools that empower markets to execute with speed and consistency.
Prioritise for strategic impact; maintain a clear model for evaluating incoming work, ensuring the team's energy is directed toward the initiatives that move the brand forward most.
Maintain visibility across market-level brand activity; build a lightweight system for monitoring our brand across markets, enabling shared learnings and coordinated planning across the region.
Deliver across a complex, high-ambition portfolio; lead multiple long-horizon initiatives simultaneously, maintaining quality and momentum in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
q: You have 8 years’ experience in brand marketing
You have experience with a number of categories and industries
You are highly creative and change excites you
You are a strong visual communicator
You use AI as a daily force multiplier — augmenting your thinking rather than replacing it, and elevating the depth and pace of your output
You are a complex problem solver who can define, assess, solve, and communicate effectively in a clear and concise fashion
You are a collaborative team player, with experience with working with teams in a matrix organization, located in the different locations while predominantly communicating virtually
You are excellent in relationship and stakeholder management
You are a persuasive and confident communicator - both written and verbal
You have worked within an agency background (desirable to have)
You are fluent in English and Arabic
x: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

d: Have you ever imagined to be part of one of the biggest food companies in the world?

Nourish life is our commitment. This is not limited to food production – it extends to projects, initiatives and causes we embrace. In order to deliver quality products, we have a team dedicated to innovating every day. We have more than 100,000 employees worldwide. A large team that has a global vision, without leaving aside the local needs.

Each member of our team is important to make BRF one of the largest food companies in the world. We are guided by values that serve as a compass for our work. Ethics in all actions, transparency in our value chain and innovation are non-negotiable points for us.
Come and join us to be part of this food giant!
BRF values and promotes an inclusive and diverse culture. We consider persons with disabilities for all our opportunities.
q: Diploma in General Nursing with a valid/approved Ministry of Health license
Minimum 2–3 years of relevant professional experience
Knowledge of applicable Saudi Ministry of Health and Labor Law requirements related to occupational health and workplace safety
Currently based in Jeddah or willing to relocate to Jeddah, with the ability to commute to the work location approximately 1+ hour from central Jeddah
Availability to work 6 days per week, with flexibility regarding working hours as required by the operation
What competencies are key to this role?
Strong planning, coordination and follow-up skills, with the ability to work independently, stay resourceful and collaborate effectively across HSE and operational teams
Confident communication skills and the ability to work effectively with employees, contractors and stakeholders from different cultures and nationalities
Good working knowledge of MS Office, particularly Word, Excel and PowerPoint
Practical understanding of occupational health, workplace safety, emergency response, accident prevention, ergonomics and employee health monitoring
Food manufacturing experience is considered an advantage, along with familiarity with food safety, GMP, Food Defense and Food Fraud practices
What can you expect from MBRF?
Being part of a global, collaborative and dynamic working environment
Strong corporate culture with commitments to customers, employees & environment we serve
Vertical, horizontal, and cross-functional growth opportunities
Stay tuned on our Website to be aware about all the job opportunities we have!
r: Manage day-to-day occupational health and ambulatory operations, including equipment, tools, internal/external medical examinations, schedules and budget-related activities; provide first aid and support employees requiring medical assistance

Coordinate hospitalization cases and follow employees’ health progress, while supervising outsourced nurses and contractors to ensure services meet required standards, policies and contractual expectations

Plan and implement workplace health, safety and accident-prevention activities, including inspections, campaigns, competitions and employee communications; actively participate in HSE meetings, committees and related initiatives

Conduct regular field inspections, ergonomic assessments and workplace observations; identify gaps and risks, report findings, propose corrective actions and follow them through to closure with the relevant area owners

Maintain accurate daily records of medical cases, incidents, accidents and actions; keep KPIs and Safety Index records up to date, analyze sick-leave trends and provide required Occupational Health documentation to local authorities
Support incident and accident investigations, root-cause identification and preventive/corrective actions, while ensuring employees receive appropriate PPE based on their activities

Deliver and coordinate Health & Safety training for employees and visitors, maintain the training matrix, communicate weekly Toolbox Talks, keep the Emergency Plan updated and ensure employees are trained through emergency drills

Support HSE system requirements, including procedure and policy deployment, document and certificate maintenance, audit/record updates and technical advice on occupational health topics; contribute to budget preparation/control and submit purchase requests for required goods and services

Follow the company’s Food Safety Golden Rules, FSQ Policy, Good Manufacturing Practices and Personal Hygiene requirements; comply with applicable food-safety procedures and regulations, complete mandatory/refresher FSQ training, safeguard food integrity and customer safety, and report FSQ changes, suspicious acts or Food Defense/Food Fraud concerns through the required channels

d: FutureTEC is seeking an experienced Regional HR Director to lead our people strategy, HR governance, organizational development, and workforce planning across our regional operations.

This is a senior leadership role for an HR professional who combines strategic thinking with strong execution capability. The successful candidate will work closely with the CEO and leadership team to build scalable people practices, strengthen organizational capability, develop leadership talent, and ensure that FutureTEC’s HR function continues to evolve alongside the company’s growth.

Under FutureTEC’s organizational model, HR encompasses HR Operations, Talent Acquisition, and Talent Management, making this role accountable for the overall direction and effectiveness of the people function.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related discipline .
Typically 12+ years of progressive HR experience , including significant experience in a senior HR leadership position.
Strong experience managing a broad HR function encompassing HR operations, performance management, talent management, organizational development, compensation & benefits, and workforce planning .
Demonstrated experience supporting senior executives and advising CEOs, executive management, and business leaders on people and organizational matters.
Experience managing HR across multiple countries, entities, business units, or geographically dispersed operations is strongly preferred.
Strong knowledge of HR governance, organizational design, workforce planning, performance management, and employment practices.
Proven ability to establish and improve HR policies, processes, systems, and management controls.
Strong analytical and commercial awareness, including understanding of headcount budgets, workforce cost, productivity, and organizational efficiency .
Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder-management, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
High degree of integrity, discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment.
Excellent command of English ; Arabic is highly advantageous.
Experience within one or more of the following environments would be advantageous:
Technology services, IT consulting, professional services, telecommunications, financial services, multinational organizations, or large regional groups.
Previous experience in a fast-growing or transforming organization, where the candidate has helped build or significantly strengthen the HR function, would be particularly valuable.

We are looking for more than an HR administrator. The successful candidate should be able to operate as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, challenge constructively when required, translate business strategy into people priorities, and remain sufficiently hands-on to ensure strong execution.

The Regional HR Director will play an important role in building a scalable organization capable of supporting FutureTEC’s continued growth across its markets, technology practices, and service lines.
r: Develop and execute FutureTEC’s regional HR strategy in alignment with the company’s business objectives and growth plans.
Lead workforce planning and manpower budgeting , working closely with the CEO, Finance, Division Heads, and business leaders.
Drive organizational design , role clarity, grading structures, reporting lines, and workforce optimization.
Establish and maintain regional HR policies, governance frameworks, procedures, and standards .
Lead the company’s performance management framework , ensuring measurable objectives, accountability, regular reviews, and performance improvement.
Develop and oversee compensation, benefits, salary structures, incentives, and employee reward frameworks .
Lead talent management, succession planning, career development, leadership development, and employee capability-building initiatives .
Provide governance and leadership over the Talent Acquisition function , ensuring recruitment activities are aligned with approved workforce plans, budgets, and organizational priorities.
Oversee HR Operations , including contracts, employee records, onboarding, offboarding, leave management, employment changes, and HR administration.
Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws, employment regulations, and internal governance requirements across FutureTEC’s regional operations.
Lead complex employee relations, disciplinary, grievance, and performance-management matters while ensuring consistency and fairness.
Develop HR dashboards and management reporting covering headcount, turnover, recruitment, workforce cost, performance, retention, and other key people metrics.
Strengthen FutureTEC’s organizational culture, employee engagement, leadership standards, and internal communication practices .
Support senior management in organizational change, restructuring, succession, and transformation initiatives.
Continuously improve HR systems, processes, controls, documentation, and automation.
Build, develop, and lead a strong regional HR team capable of supporting FutureTEC’s continued growth.
